items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was working with Curtis Amy... at the Renaissance... According to your discography, there’s a recording with Curtis Amy and Frank Butler, Groovin’ Blue.

ctx.x: When I look at your discography, I see the name Curtis Amy. Most people don’t know who Curtis was. Could you talk about him?
Great, Curtis Amy was great. Curtis Amy played tenor saxophone. Most of his songs – he wrote a lot of songs, funky type songs that were a lot of fun. One More Ham Hog Please.
